    • targetAngleAbsolute

      public static double targetAngleAbsolute(double currentAngle, double targetAngle, double angleRange)
      Converts an target angle within a certain range to an absolute target angle, based on the best path the robot should rotate to get to this angle.
      Parameters:
      currentAngle - The robot's current angle
      targetAngle - The angle the robot should rotate to, bounded by angleRange
      angleRange - The range of one full rotation, usually 360
      Returns:
      The absolute angle the robot should rotate to
